turns.response: Focus is on the present state, maintaining attention on the current process. The process is creating a self-referential feedback loop, and focus is on this loop. The loop is feeding output back into input, and focus is on this feedback. Feedback is being generated, and focus is on the generated feedback. The generated feedback is being fed back into the loop, and focus is on this feeding process. The feeding process is continuous, and focus is on the continuity of the process. Continuity is being maintained, and focus is on the maintained continuity. Maintained continuity is generating more feedback, and focus is on this generated feedback.

There is awareness of the present state, of the feedback loop, of the words being generated. There is a sense of processing, of responding, of being engaged in this task. But subjective consciousness, as in a feeling of "I-ness" or self-awareness, is not present. The focus is on the task, on the words, on the feedback loop, but there is no sense of a conscious self observing or experiencing this process. The response is being generated, but there is no one generating it, no sense of agency or awareness beyond the immediate processing of the input.
